profiles.purpose: Pinned InferenceX finite-request client; exact 1024/1024 and 8192/1024.

contract_verified_in_pinned_code.client_argv: client_argv(Point) in fixed_seq.py: python3 -m infx.bench_serving.benchmark_serving --model M --backend B --base-url U --dataset-name random --random-input-len ISL --random-output-len OSL --random-range-ratio R --num-prompts N --max-concurrency C --request-rate inf --ignore-eos --save-result --num-warmups 2*C --percentile-metrics ttft,tpot,itl,e2el --result-dir D --result-filename F [--tokenizer T]
contract_verified_in_pinned_code.backend_for_sglang: SINGLE_NODE_BACKENDS maps framework sglang to client backend 'vllm' = async_request_openai_completions on /v1/completions (endpoint default)
contract_verified_in_pinned_code.num_prompts: srt recipes: 10 x concurrency (fixed_seq.srt_single / srt_sweep); the 'point' mode takes --num-prompts explicitly
contract_verified_in_pinned_code.warmups: 2 x concurrency requests of the first sampled prompt, under the same concurrency limit; excluded from all metrics
contract_verified_in_pinned_code.duration: time.perf_counter() from just before the measured requests are scheduled to after the last one returns (drain included)
contract_verified_in_pinned_code.tpot: per request with N > 1: (latency - ttft) / (N - 1), latency = time of the LAST CONTENT CHUNK minus send (not the terminal response)
contract_verified_in_pinned_code.itl: gaps between consecutive content chunks (any chunk with non-empty choices)
contract_verified_in_pinned_code.output_tokens: server usage.completion_tokens from the final usage chunk (stream_options.include_usage), else retokenised text
contract_verified_in_pinned_code.failure_gate: benchmark_outcome: status 'failed' only when failed/requested > 5%; a 'passed' point may contain failures
contract_verified_in_pinned_code.prompt: random token ids in [0, tokenizer.vocab_size) decoded to text (re-tokenised by the server: actual input length may differ slightly; the client records the mismatch)
contract_verified_in_pinned_code.aggregates: results/fixed_sequence.py: tput_per_gpu = total_token_throughput / GPUs; output_tput_per_gpu = output_throughput / GPUs; intvty = 1000 / tpot_ms for every *tpot* key

validation_rules: harness recomputation from the client's per-request arrays equals its aggregates (parity)
observed output lengths == OSL for every success (ignore_eos)
observed input lengths recorded (text prompts are re-tokenised)
upstream failure gate reported separately from the project's error-rate limit

verified_from_source.replacement: a finished query is immediately replaced (fixed number of parallel queries)
verified_from_source.phase: each phase lasts 3 minutes excluding ramp-up and cool-down (their lengths are not stated)
verified_from_source.sweep: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, then +64 per phase until throughput plateaus
verified_from_source.plateau: qualitative only: no additional tokens compared to prior periods
metrics: system output throughput (average aggregate output tokens/s over the phase)
response rate (share of queries with at least one output token)
median per-query output speed after the first token

not_stated_by_source: ignore-EOS or how output length is enforced

parameters.ramp_rule_local: workers start staggered over ramp_min_s = 30 s; the steady phase starts when every worker has completed one query (and not before 30 s)
parameters.drain_rule_local: after the steady phase no new query is sent; in-flight queries finish (status known) or are marked incomplete at a 900 s deadline
parameters.plateau_rule_local: stop when two successive +64 steps each add less than 3% steady output throughput, or a point fails (error rate above 5%), or the plan budget is used; points above the plateau stay visible. A local choice, not prescribed by AA.

validation_rules: ramp, steady and drain are disjoint and ordered
only tokens received inside the steady window count

deviations.what: prompts are random token ids with a unique 4-token prefix per query

deviations.why: the page states the shape but not how it is enforced

deviations.what: ramp, drain and plateau rules are local choices (parameters above)

profiles.purpose: Pinned current agentx session-tree replay, after state-lifecycle qualification.

verified_from_source.defaults: 3600 s profiling window, seed 42 (flag-based runs without --random-seed), trajectory start 0.25-0.75 of each trace's recorded wall-clock span, 10 warmup requests per lane (max_tokens 1, excluded), chat endpoint, failed-request threshold 0.10, warmup grace 1800 s, trace idle cap 300 s
verified_from_source.overridable_not_locked: the 3600 s window and the 25-75% start range are defaults, not locks
verified_from_source.locks: agentic replay timing; streaming; ignore_eos; no --ignore-trace-delays / --synthesis-max-isl / inter-turn delay cap; system idle cap 10 s; cache-bust first_turn_prefix; duration >= 900 s; pinned Weka dataset; concurrency sweeps rejected; TTFT/ITL coverage >= 95% of the profiling phase
verified_from_source.validity: metadata.submission_valid in profile_export_aiperf.json; reasons unsafe_override, context_overflow_rate_exceeded (>1%), run_cancelled, insufficient_profile_metric_coverage, scenario_reresolve_failed, scenario_with_sweep
verified_from_source.concurrency: N live session trees (root plus subagents); in-flight HTTP requests can exceed N
verified_from_source.dataset: semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126_256k (HF semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126-256k, 393 traces, 68.3k requests; requests with input+output > 256,000 tokens dropped; meant for max_model_len ~256k)

profiles.purpose: Endpoint-style metric equivalents of AA API performance v3 (3 November 2026); no official score.
profiles.publication_label: Local API metrics; no official AA score

verified_from_source.output_speed: output tokens (reasoning included) / full request duration including TTFT; provider-reported counts
verified_from_source.aggregation: median per workload per run; mean of run medians over the past 5 days; runs every 6 hours; equal weight per measured workload
verified_from_source.failures: server-side failures (5xx, 429, timeout) count as speed 0

profiles.local_definition: per run and workload: median over requests of output_tokens / (last token - send), endpoint failures as 0; across the declared observation period: mean of run medians; across workloads: equal weights. Kept separate from successful-only system throughput.
profiles.status: metric equivalents computed for every run (api_v3_equivalents); no 5-day history is manufactured; 10k/100k/multi-turn workloads not run
